description.sk: Vrstvy cestovín, mletého mäsa so škoricou a hustého bešamelu, zapečené dozlatista.
description.en: Layers of pasta, cinnamon-spiced minced meat and thick béchamel, baked until golden.

note.sk: dlhé rúrky, napr. bucatini alebo penne
note.en: long tubes such as bucatini, or penne

steps.sk: Na oleji opeč nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu 5 minút, pridaj mäso a opekaj ho na vysokom ohni 8 minút, kým sa nerozpadne a nezhnedne. Pridaj cesnak, škoricu, nové korenie, passatu a polovicu soli a var 15 minút, kým omáčka nezhustne.
steps.en: Fry the finely chopped onion in the oil for 5 minutes, add the meat and brown it over a high heat for 8 minutes, breaking it up. Add the garlic, cinnamon, allspice, passata and half the salt and simmer for 15 minutes until thick.

steps.sk: Cestoviny uvar v osolenej vode o 2 minúty kratšie, ako je na obale – dovaria sa v rúre. Sceď ich a premiešaj s 2 lyžicami parmezánu a jedným rozšľahaným vajcom, aby držali pokope.
steps.en: Cook the pasta in salted water for 2 minutes less than the packet says; it finishes cooking in the oven. Drain and mix with 2 tablespoons of Parmesan and one beaten egg so it holds together.

steps.sk: Na bešamel rozpusti maslo, vmiešaj múku a 2 minúty ju opekaj. Za stáleho šľahania prilievaj mlieko a var 5 minút, kým nie je hustý. Odstav, vmiešaj muškátový oriešok, zvyšnú soľ, parmezán (2 lyžice odlož) a druhé vajce.
steps.en: For the béchamel melt the butter, stir in the flour and cook for 2 minutes. Whisk in the milk and simmer for 5 minutes until thick. Take off the heat and stir in the nutmeg, the remaining salt, the Parmesan (keep 2 tablespoons back) and the second egg.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 180 °C. Do misy asi 30 × 20 cm daj polovicu cestovín, navrch mäsovú omáčku a zvyšné cestoviny. Zalej bešamelom, uhlaď a posyp odloženým parmezánom.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Put half the pasta in a dish of about 30 × 20 cm, spread over the meat sauce and top with the remaining pasta. Pour over the béchamel, smooth it and sprinkle with the reserved Parmesan.

steps.sk: Peč 40 až 45 minút do zlatohneda. Nechaj aspoň 15 minút odpočívať, aby sa dalo pekne krájať. Porcie vydržia v chladničke 4 dni a dajú sa zamraziť.
steps.en: Bake for 40 to 45 minutes until golden brown. Rest for at least 15 minutes so it cuts neatly. Portions keep in the fridge for 4 days and can be frozen.

title.sk: Avgolemono – kuracia polievka s citrónom a vajcom
title.en: Avgolemono: chicken soup with egg and lemon

description.sk: Hodvábna grécka polievka s ryžou, kuracím mäsom a vaječno-citrónovou zátrepkou.
description.en: A silky Greek soup with rice and chicken, thickened with egg and lemon.

steps.sk: Do hrnca daj kuracie prsia, cibuľu na polovice, mrkvu, bujón a 1,5 litra vody. Priveď do varu, zober penu a var na miernom ohni 20 minút, kým mäso nie je hotové – vo vnútri biele, bez ružovej farby.
steps.en: Put the chicken breasts, halved onion, carrot, stock cube and 1.5 litres of water in a pot. Bring to the boil, skim and simmer gently for 20 minutes until the chicken is cooked: white inside with no pink.

steps.sk: Mäso vyber a natrhaj vidličkami na prúžky, cibuľu a mrkvu vyhoď. Do vývaru pridaj ryžu a var 15 minút doměkka.
steps.en: Lift out the chicken and shred it with two forks; discard the onion and carrot. Add the rice to the broth and simmer for 15 minutes until tender.

steps.sk: Vajcia vyšľahaj v miske do peny a pridaj šťavu z oboch citrónov. Za stáleho šľahania prilievaj k vajciam po lyžiciach asi 2 naberačky horúceho vývaru – vajcia sa tak zohrejú pomaly a nezrazia sa.
steps.en: Whisk the eggs in a bowl until frothy and add the juice of both lemons. Whisking all the time, add about 2 ladles of the hot broth a spoonful at a time; this warms the eggs slowly so they do not curdle.

steps.sk: Hrniec odstav z ohňa, vlej doň vaječnú zmes a miešaj, kým polievka nezhustne a nie je hodvábna. Vráť mäso a na miernom ohni zohrievaj 2 minúty – polievka už nesmie vrieť.
steps.en: Take the pot off the heat, pour in the egg mixture and stir until the soup thickens and turns silky. Return the chicken and warm over a low heat for 2 minutes; the soup must not boil again.

steps.sk: Dochuť korením a podávaj posypané kôprom. Polievku zohrievaj len jemne, prudkým varom by sa vajcia zrazili.
steps.en: Season with pepper and serve sprinkled with dill. Reheat only gently, as boiling would curdle the eggs.

title.sk: Stifado – hovädzie s cibuľkou a škoricou
title.en: Stifado: beef with baby onions and cinnamon

description.sk: Grécky pomaly dusený guláš s celými cibuľkami, červeným vínom, škoricou a klinčekmi.
description.en: A slow-cooked Greek stew with whole small onions, red wine, cinnamon and cloves.

steps.sk: Mäso nakrájaj na kocky asi 4 cm a osuš. V hrnci rozpáľ olej a mäso opekaj po častiach na vysokom ohni, kým nie je zo všetkých strán hnedé. Vyber ho.
steps.en: Cut the beef into roughly 4 cm cubes and pat dry. Heat the oil in a pot and brown the meat in batches over a high heat until browned all over. Lift it out.

steps.sk: Šalotky zalej na minútu vriacou vodou – potom sa ľahko ošúpu. Celé ich opeč na výpekoch 5 minút dozlatista. Pridaj cesnak a pretlak a minútu opekaj.
steps.en: Pour boiling water over the shallots for a minute; they then peel easily. Fry them whole in the pan juices for 5 minutes until golden. Add the garlic and tomato paste and fry for a minute.

steps.sk: Podlej vínom a octom a nechaj 2 minúty variť. Vráť mäso, pridaj paradajky, škoricu, klinčeky, bobkové listy, soľ a 300 ml vody. Dus pod pokrievkou na miernom ohni 2 hodiny, kým mäso nie je veľmi mäkké.
steps.en: Pour in the wine and vinegar and let it bubble for 2 minutes. Return the meat and add the tomatoes, cinnamon, cloves, bay leaves, salt and 300 ml of water. Braise, covered, over a low heat for 2 hours until the meat is very tender.

steps.sk: Počas dusenia nemiešaj vareškou, aby sa cibuľky nerozpadli – iba občas hrncom zatras. Ak sa šťava príliš odparí, podlej trochou vody; na konci má byť hustá a lesklá.
steps.en: Do not stir with a spoon while braising so the onions stay whole; just shake the pot now and then. If the sauce reduces too much, add a little water; at the end it should be thick and glossy.

steps.sk: Vylov škoricu, klinčeky a bobkové listy. Podávaj s ryžou alebo chlebom. Stifado je na druhý deň ešte lepšie a dá sa zamraziť.
steps.en: Fish out the cinnamon, cloves and bay leaves. Serve with rice or bread. Stifado is even better the next day and freezes well.

description.sk: Grécke mäsové placky s oreganom a mätou, v strede s roztopenou fetou.
description.en: Greek meat patties with oregano and mint, with melting feta in the middle.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nastrúhaj na jemnom strúhadle aj so šťavou – placky budú šťavnatejšie. Mätu nasekaj. V miske zmiešaj mäso, cibuľu, prelisovaný cesnak, strúhanku, vajce, oregano, mätu, soľ a korenie a dôkladne ho premiešaj rukou.
steps.en: Grate the onion finely, juice and all; it makes the patties juicier. Chop the mint. Mix the meat, onion, crushed garlic, breadcrumbs, egg, oregano, mint, salt and pepper in a bowl and work it together well by hand.

steps.sk: Mäso rozdeľ na 8 dielov. Každý splošti na dlani, do stredu polož kúsok fety a okraje uzavri tak, aby bol syr úplne skrytý. Vytvaruj oválne placky hrubé asi 2 cm.
steps.en: Divide the meat into 8 portions. Flatten each in your palm, put a piece of feta in the middle and close the edges so the cheese is completely hidden. Shape into oval patties about 2 cm thick.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C. Na panvici rozpáľ olej a placky opeč na vysokom ohni 2 minúty z každej strany do hneda. Prelož ich na plech.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Heat the oil in a pan and brown the patties over a high heat for 2 minutes per side. Transfer them to a baking tray.

steps.sk: Dopeč ich v rúre 12 až 15 minút, kým nie sú vo vnútri prepečené – bez ružovej farby – a feta sa neroztopí. Podávaj s teplou pitou, jogurtom a paradajkovým šalátom.
steps.en: Finish them in the oven for 12 to 15 minutes until cooked through with no pink inside and the feta has melted. Serve with warm pita, yogurt and a tomato salad.

title.sk: Giouvetsi – hovädzie s cestovinami z rúry

description.sk: Hovädzie dusené s paradajkami a škoricou, dopečené s drobnými cestovinami.
description.en: Beef braised with tomatoes and cinnamon, then baked with small pasta.

steps.sk: Mäso nakrájaj na kocky asi 3 cm. V hrnci vhodnom do rúry rozpáľ olej a mäso opeč zo všetkých strán do hneda. Pridaj nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu a cesnak a opekaj 4 minúty.
steps.en: Cut the beef into roughly 3 cm cubes. Heat the oil in an ovenproof pot and brown the meat on all sides. Add the finely chopped onion and garlic and fry for 4 minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj paradajky, škoricu, bobkový list, soľ a 400 ml vody a dus pod pokrievkou na miernom ohni 75 minút, kým mäso nezmäkne.
steps.en: Add the tomatoes, cinnamon, bay leaf, salt and 400 ml of water and braise, covered, over a low heat for 75 minutes until the meat is tender.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 190 °C. Do hrnca prilej 600 ml horúcej vody s bujónom, vsyp cestoviny a premiešaj. Hrniec daj odkrytý do rúry.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 190 °C. Pour 600 ml of hot water with the stock cube into the pot, add the pasta and stir. Put the pot into the oven uncovered.

steps.sk: Peč 20 až 25 minút a v polovici raz premiešaj, kým cestoviny nevpijú tekutinu, nie sú mäkké a navrchu sa jemne opečú. Ak vyschnú skôr, prilej trochu vody.
steps.en: Bake for 20 to 25 minutes, stirring once halfway, until the pasta has absorbed the liquid, is tender and slightly crisp on top. If it dries out too soon, add a little water.

steps.sk: Vylov škoricu a bobkový list a podávaj posypané rozdrobenou fetou.
steps.en: Remove the cinnamon and bay leaf and serve sprinkled with crumbled feta.

description.sk: Vegánske grécke jedlo z fazuľky, zemiakov a paradajok dusených v olivovom oleji.
description.en: A vegan Greek dish of green beans, potatoes and tomatoes stewed in olive oil.

steps.sk: Fazuľke odstráň konce a nakrájaj ju na polovice. Zemiaky ošúp a nakrájaj na väčšie kusy, cibuľu na polkolieska a cesnak na plátky.
steps.en: Trim the beans and cut them in half. Peel the potatoes and cut them into large chunks, the onion into half-moons and the garlic into slices.

steps.sk: V širokom hrnci zohrej olej a cibuľu opekaj 5 minút do mäkka. Pridaj cesnak, potom fazuľku a 3 minúty ju opekaj, aby sa obalila olejom.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a wide pan and fry the onion for 5 minutes until soft. Add the garlic, then the beans, and fry for 3 minutes to coat them in the oil.

steps.sk: Pridaj zemiaky, paradajky, cukor, soľ a 250 ml vody. Prikry a dus na miernom ohni 40 minút, kým fazuľka nie je úplne mäkká a omáčka hustá. Grécka fazuľka sa nevarí do chrumkava, má byť mäkká.
steps.en: Add the potatoes, tomatoes, sugar, salt and 250 ml of water. Cover and cook over a low heat for 40 minutes until the beans are completely soft and the sauce is thick. Greek beans are not cooked crisp; they should be tender.

steps.sk: Posyp nasekanou vňaťou a podávaj teplé alebo vlažné s chlebom, prípadne s fetou. V chladničke vydrží 4 dni a na druhý deň chutí ešte lepšie.
steps.en: Sprinkle with chopped parsley and serve warm or lukewarm with bread, and feta if you like. It keeps in the fridge for 4 days and tastes even better the next day.

description.sk: Grécka vegánska ryža so špenátom, jarnou cibuľkou, kôprom a citrónom.
description.en: Greek vegan rice with spinach, spring onions, dill and lemon.

steps.sk: Cibuľu a jarnú cibuľku nakrájaj nadrobno. Špenát umy a nahrubo nasekaj. V širokom hrnci zohrej olej a cibuľu opekaj 5 minút dosklovita.
steps.en: Finely chop the onion and spring onions. Wash and roughly chop the spinach. Heat the oil in a wide pan and fry the onions for 5 minutes until translucent.

steps.sk: Pridaj pretlak a ryžu a 2 minúty ju opekaj. Po častiach pridávaj špenát a miešaj, kým nezvädne.
steps.en: Add the tomato paste and rice and fry for 2 minutes. Add the spinach in batches, stirring until it wilts.

steps.sk: Zalej 500 ml horúcej vody s bujónom, prikry a var na miernom ohni 15 minút, kým ryža nie je mäkká a nevpije tekutinu. Ryža má zostať vláčna, nie suchá.
steps.en: Pour in 500 ml of hot water with the stock cube, cover and simmer gently for 15 minutes until the rice is tender and has absorbed the liquid. It should stay moist, not dry.

steps.sk: Vmiešaj nasekaný kôpor, šťavu z citróna a korenie. Podávaj teplé, podľa chuti s rozdrobenou fetou. V chladničke vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: Stir in the chopped dill, the lemon juice and pepper. Serve warm, with crumbled feta if you like. It keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

title.sk: Revithada – pečený cícer s citrónom a rozmarínom
title.en: Revithada: baked chickpeas with lemon and rosemary

description.sk: Cícer pomaly pečený s cibuľou, olivovým olejom, citrónom a rozmarínom, vegánsky.
description.en: Chickpeas slow-baked with onion, olive oil, lemon and rosemary, vegan.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 180 °C. Cibuľu nakrájaj na tenké polkolieska, cesnak na plátky. Cícer prepláchni a nechaj odkvapkať.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Slice the onions thinly into half-moons and the garlic into slices. Rinse and drain the chickpeas.

steps.sk: Do zapekacej misy s pokrievkou alebo do hrnca do rúry daj cícer, cibuľu, cesnak, rozmarín, bobkové listy, olej, korenie a 400 ml horúcej vody s bujónom. Premiešaj.
steps.en: Put the chickpeas, onions, garlic, rosemary, bay leaves, oil, pepper and 400 ml of hot water with the stock cube into a lidded baking dish or ovenproof pot. Stir.

steps.sk: Prikry a peč 45 minút, potom odkry, pridaj šťavu z citróna a peč ďalších 15 minút, kým šťava nezhustne a cibuľa sa nerozplynie do krémovej omáčky.
steps.en: Cover and bake for 45 minutes, then uncover, add the lemon juice and bake for another 15 minutes until the liquid thickens and the onions melt into a creamy sauce.

steps.sk: Bobkové listy vyber. Niekoľko cícerov roztlač o stenu misy, aby omáčka zhustla. Podávaj s chlebom. V chladničke vydrží 4 dni.
steps.en: Remove the bay leaves. Crush a few chickpeas against the side of the dish to thicken the sauce. Serve with bread. It keeps in the fridge for 4 days.

title.sk: Kotopoulo kokkinisto – kura v paradajkách so škoricou
title.en: Kotopoulo kokkinisto: chicken in tomato with cinnamon

description.sk: Kuracie stehná dusené v paradajkovej omáčke so škoricou, podávané s cestovinami.
description.en: Chicken thighs braised in tomato sauce with cinnamon, served with pasta.

steps.sk: Stehná osoľ. V širokom hrnci rozpáľ olej a mäso opeč na vysokom ohni 3 minúty z každej strany do zlatista. Vyber ho na tanier.
steps.en: Salt the chicken. Heat the oil in a wide pot and brown the meat over a high heat for 3 minutes per side until golden. Lift onto a plate.

steps.sk: Na výpekoch opekaj nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu 5 minút, pridaj cesnak a pretlak a minútu opekaj. Pridaj paradajky, škoricu, nové korenie, bobkový list a 200 ml vody.
steps.en: Fry the finely chopped onion in the juices for 5 minutes, add the garlic and tomato paste and fry for a minute. Add the tomatoes, cinnamon, allspice, bay leaf and 200 ml of water.

steps.sk: Vráť mäso do omáčky, prikry a dus na miernom ohni 40 minút, kým sa mäso ľahko neoddeľuje od kosti a omáčka nie je hustá a tmavočervená.
steps.en: Return the chicken to the sauce, cover and simmer over a low heat for 40 minutes until the meat comes away easily from the bone and the sauce is thick and deep red.

steps.sk: Medzitým uvar špagety v osolenej vode al dente. Vylov škoricu a bobkový list a podávaj kura s omáčkou na cestovinách, posypané parmezánom.
steps.en: Meanwhile cook the spaghetti in salted water until al dente. Fish out the cinnamon and bay leaf and serve the chicken and sauce over the pasta, sprinkled with Parmesan.

title.sk: Htipiti – pikantný krém z fety a papriky
title.en: Htipiti: spicy whipped feta and pepper

description.sk: Grécka nátierka z rozšľahanej fety s pečenou paprikou, čili a olivovým olejom.
description.en: A Greek spread of whipped feta with roasted pepper, chilli and olive oil.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 230 °C. Papriky upeč celé na plechu 20 až 25 minút, kým šupka nezčernie. Daj ich do misky, prikry a nechaj 10 minút zapariť, potom ich ošúp a vyber semienka.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 230 °C. Roast the whole peppers on a tray for 20 to 25 minutes until the skins blacken. Put them in a bowl, cover and leave to steam for 10 minutes, then peel and deseed.

steps.sk: Fetu rozdrob do mixéra, pridaj jogurt, olej, čili a lyžičku citrónovej šťavy a mixuj, kým nie je krém hladký a nadýchaný.
steps.en: Crumble the feta into the blender, add the yogurt, oil, chilli and a teaspoon of lemon juice and blend until smooth and fluffy.

steps.sk: Pridaj papriku nakrájanú na kúsky a len krátko pulzuj, aby v kréme zostali drobné kúsky papriky.
steps.en: Add the pepper in pieces and pulse just briefly so small pieces of pepper remain in the cream.

steps.sk: Prelož do misky, pokvapkaj olejom a posyp oreganom. Podávaj s teplou pitou alebo zeleninou. V chladničke vydrží 4 dni.
steps.en: Spoon into a bowl, drizzle with oil and sprinkle with oregano. Serve with warm pita or vegetables. It keeps in the fridge for 4 days.

title.sk: Kuracie stehná v jogurtovej marináde s oreganom
title.en: Yogurt and oregano marinated chicken thighs

description.sk: Šťavnaté stehná marinované v jogurte s citrónom a cesnakom, upečené so zemiakmi.
description.en: Juicy thighs marinated in yogurt with lemon and garlic, roasted with potatoes.

steps.sk: Jogurt zmiešaj s prelisovaným cesnakom, šťavou a kôrou z polovice citróna, oreganom, paprikou, polovicou soli a lyžicou oleja. Stehná v marináde obaľ a nechaj v chladničke aspoň 2 hodiny.
steps.en: Mix the yogurt with the crushed garlic, the juice and zest of half the lemon, the oregano, paprika, half the salt and a spoonful of oil. Coat the chicken in the marinade and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 210 °C. Zemiaky ošúp, nakrájaj na mesiačiky, premiešaj so zvyšným olejom, soľou, korením a šťavou zo zvyšného citróna a rozlož na plech.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 210 °C. Peel the potatoes, cut into wedges, toss with the remaining oil, salt, pepper and the juice of the other lemon half and spread on a tray.

steps.sk: Zemiaky peč 15 minút, potom medzi ne polož stehná – prebytočnú marinádu nechaj odkvapkať. Peč ďalších 25 až 30 minút, kým mäso nie je opečené a vo vnútri biele s čírou šťavou.
steps.en: Roast the potatoes for 15 minutes, then lay the chicken among them, letting excess marinade drip off. Roast for another 25 to 30 minutes until the chicken is browned and white inside with clear juices.

steps.sk: Podávaj so zeleninovým šalátom alebo tzatziki. Do krabičiek sa hodí aj s ryžou; v chladničke vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: Serve with a green salad or tzatziki. It also suits lunchboxes with rice and keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

description.sk: Chrumkavé placky z nasekaných paradajok, cibule, mäty a múky, vegánska desiata.
description.en: Crisp fritters of chopped tomatoes, onion, mint and flour, a vegan snack.

steps.sk: Cherry paradajky nakrájaj na drobné kúsky a daj ich do sitka, posoľ a nechaj 10 minút odkvapkať – placky inak nebudú držať pokope. Šťavu nevylievaj, môže sa hodiť.
steps.en: Chop the cherry tomatoes finely, put them in a sieve, salt them and let them drain for 10 minutes; otherwise the fritters will not hold together. Keep the juice in case you need it.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno a mätu nasekaj. V miske zmiešaj paradajky, cibuľu, mätu, oregano, múku a kypriaci prášok na husté lepivé cesto. Ak je príliš suché, pridaj lyžicu šťavy z paradajok.
steps.en: Finely chop the onion and mint. In a bowl mix the tomatoes, onion, mint, oregano, flour and baking powder into a thick, sticky batter. If it is too dry, add a spoonful of the tomato juice.

steps.sk: Na panvici rozpáľ olej na strednom až vysokom ohni. Ukladaj po lyžiciach kôpky cesta a jemne ich splošti na placky hrubé 1 cm.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a pan over a medium-high heat. Drop in spoonfuls of batter and flatten them gently into fritters about 1 cm thick.

steps.sk: Vyprážaj 2 až 3 minúty z každej strany, kým nie sú zlatohnedé a chrumkavé. Vyberaj ich na papierovú utierku. Podávaj teplé s citrónom a jogurtom alebo tzatziki.
steps.en: Fry for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden brown and crisp. Drain on kitchen paper. Serve warm with lemon and yogurt or tzatziki.

description.sk: Libanonské kuracie špízy marinované v jogurte a citróne s krémovou cesnakovou omáčkou.
description.en: Lebanese chicken skewers marinated in yogurt and lemon with a creamy garlic sauce.

note.sk: 100 g do marinády, 150 g do omáčky
note.en: 100 g for the marinade, 150 g for the sauce

steps.sk: Mäso nakrájaj na kocky asi 3 cm. Zmiešaj 100 g jogurtu, šťavu z polovice citróna, 2 prelisované strúčiky cesnaku, pretlak, papriku, oregano, 2 lyžice oleja a väčšinu soli. Mäso v marináde obaľ a daj aspoň na 2 hodiny do chladničky.
steps.en: Cut the chicken into roughly 3 cm cubes. Mix 100 g of the yogurt, the juice of half the lemon, 2 crushed garlic cloves, the tomato paste, paprika, oregano, 2 tablespoons of oil and most of the salt. Coat the meat and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.

steps.sk: Na omáčku rozotri zvyšný cesnak so štipkou soli na pastu, vmiešaj zvyšný jogurt, lyžicu oleja a trochu citrónovej šťavy. Omáčka má byť výrazne cesnaková – v Libanone sa volá toum.
steps.en: For the sauce crush the remaining garlic with a pinch of salt to a paste and stir in the remaining yogurt, a spoonful of oil and a little lemon juice. The sauce should be strongly garlicky; in Lebanon a similar sauce is called toum.

steps.sk: Drevené špajdle namoč na 20 minút do vody. Rúru predhrej na 230 °C s grilom. Mäso napichaj na špajdle a ulož na mriežku nad plech.
steps.en: Soak wooden skewers in water for 20 minutes. Preheat the oven to 230 °C with the grill on. Thread the chicken onto the skewers and lay them on a rack over a tray.

steps.sk: Griluj 12 až 15 minút, v polovici otoč, kým mäso nie je na okrajoch opečené a vo vnútri biele, bez ružovej farby. Nechaj ho 3 minúty odpočívať.
steps.en: Grill for 12 to 15 minutes, turning halfway, until the chicken is charred at the edges and white inside with no pink. Let it rest for 3 minutes.

steps.sk: Podávaj v teplej pite s cesnakovou omáčkou a plátkami paradajok, prípadne s ryžou. Mäso vydrží v chladničke 3 dni a je dobré aj studené.
steps.en: Serve in warm pita with the garlic sauce and sliced tomatoes, or with rice. The chicken keeps in the fridge for 3 days and is good cold.

description.sk: Sypký bulgur uvarený s paradajkami, paprikou a cibuľou, vegánska príloha aj jedlo.
description.en: Fluffy bulgur cooked with tomatoes, pepper and onion, a vegan side or main.

steps.sk: Cibuľu a papriku nakrájaj na drobné kocky, paradajky nastrúhaj na hrubom strúhadle. V hrnci zohrej olej a cibuľu s paprikou opekaj 6 minút do mäkka.
steps.en: Dice the onion and pepper small and coarsely grate the tomatoes. Heat the oil in a pan and fry the onion and pepper for 6 minutes until soft.

steps.sk: Pridaj pretlak a čili, minútu opekaj, potom paradajky a var 3 minúty. Vsyp bulgur a 2 minúty ho opekaj, aby sa obalil omáčkou.
steps.en: Add the tomato paste and chilli and fry for a minute, then add the tomatoes and cook for 3 minutes. Stir in the bulgur and toast for 2 minutes so it is coated in the sauce.

steps.sk: Zalej 500 ml horúcej vody s bujónom, priveď do varu, prikry a na minimálnom ohni var 12 minút, kým bulgur nevpije tekutinu.
steps.en: Pour in 500 ml of hot water with the stock cube, bring to the boil, cover and cook on the lowest heat for 12 minutes until the bulgur has absorbed the liquid.

steps.sk: Odstav, medzi hrniec a pokrievku vlož utierku a nechaj 10 minút dôjsť – bulgur bude sypký. Prečechraj ho vidličkou, posyp mätou a podávaj s jogurtom. V chladničke vydrží 4 dni.
steps.en: Take off the heat, put a tea towel between the pot and the lid and leave for 10 minutes; the bulgur turns fluffy. Fluff with a fork, sprinkle with mint and serve with yogurt. It keeps in the fridge for 4 days.

description.sk: Turecké pečené baklažány rozrezané a naplnené mletým mäsom s paprikou a paradajkami.
description.en: Turkish baked aubergines split open and filled with minced meat, peppers and tomatoes.

steps.sk: Baklažány ošúp v pruhoch – striedavo nechaj pás šupky a pás ošúpaný, aby držali tvar. Potri ich 3 lyžicami oleja, posyp polovicou soli a peč pri 200 °C 25 minút, kým nezmäknú a nezačnú sa prepadať.
steps.en: Peel the aubergines in stripes, alternating peeled and unpeeled strips so they hold their shape. Brush with 3 tablespoons of oil, sprinkle with half the salt and roast at 200 °C for 25 minutes until soft and starting to collapse.

steps.sk: Medzitým na zvyšnom oleji opeč nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu a papriku 5 minút, pridaj mäso a opekaj 6 minút, kým sa nerozpadne a nezhnedne. Pridaj cesnak, pretlak, papriku, dve nakrájané paradajky a zvyšnú soľ a var 5 minút.
steps.en: Meanwhile fry the finely chopped onion and pepper in the remaining oil for 5 minutes, add the meat and brown it for 6 minutes, breaking it up. Add the garlic, tomato paste, paprika, two chopped tomatoes and the remaining salt and cook for 5 minutes.

steps.sk: Baklažány ulož do zapekacej misy a do každého urob pozdĺžny rez do hĺbky, nie až na spodok. Lyžicou ho roztvor do tvaru loďky a naplň mäsovou zmesou.
steps.en: Lay the aubergines in a baking dish and cut a deep lengthways slit in each, not right through the bottom. Open it with a spoon into a boat shape and fill with the meat mixture.

steps.sk: Navrch polož plátky zvyšnej paradajky, do misy nalej 150 ml vody a peč 25 minút, kým paradajky nezmäknú a baklažány nie sú úplne mäkké.
steps.en: Top with slices of the remaining tomato, pour 150 ml of water into the dish and bake for 25 minutes until the tomatoes have softened and the aubergines are completely tender.

steps.sk: Posyp petržlenovou vňaťou a podávaj s jogurtom a ryžou alebo chlebom.
steps.en: Sprinkle with parsley and serve with yogurt and rice or bread.

description.sk: Pikantné turecké kebaby z jahňacieho mäsa s paprikou a čili, s cibuľovým šalátom.
description.en: Spicy Turkish lamb kebabs with paprika and chilli, served with an onion salad.

note.en: 1 for the meat, 1 for the salad

steps.sk: Jednu cibuľu a papriku nakrájaj nadrobno, najlepšie v mixéri, a dôkladne vytlač šťavu cez utierku – mokré mäso by sa na špízoch neudržalo.
steps.en: Finely chop one onion and the pepper, ideally in a processor, and squeeze out the juice thoroughly through a towel; wet meat will not stay on the skewers.

steps.sk: Mäso zmiešaj s cibuľou, paprikou, prelisovaným cesnakom, čili, paprikou, rascou a soľou a 3 minúty ho mies rukou, kým nie je lepkavé a súdržné. Daj ho na 20 minút do chladničky.
steps.en: Mix the lamb with the onion, pepper, crushed garlic, chilli, paprika, cumin and salt and knead by hand for 3 minutes until sticky and cohesive. Chill for 20 minutes.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 240 °C s grilom. Mäso rozdeľ na 8 dielov a mokrými rukami ho natlač na ploché špajdle alebo vytvaruj podlhovasté valčeky dlhé 15 cm. Ulož ich na mriežku nad plech.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 240 °C with the grill on. Divide the meat into 8 and, with wet hands, press it onto flat skewers or shape long logs about 15 cm. Lay them on a rack over a tray.

steps.sk: Griluj 10 až 12 minút, v polovici otoč, kým nie sú zvonku opečené a vo vnútri prepečené. Medzitým nakrájaj druhú cibuľu na tenké polkolieska a premiešaj s vňaťou, citrónovou šťavou a štipkou papriky.
steps.en: Grill for 10 to 12 minutes, turning halfway, until browned outside and cooked through. Meanwhile slice the second onion thinly and toss with the parsley, lemon juice and a pinch of paprika.

steps.sk: Kebaby podávaj na teplých plackách s cibuľovým šalátom a jogurtom.
steps.en: Serve the kebabs on warm flatbreads with the onion salad and yogurt.

description.sk: Turecké tenké placky plnené špenátom a fetou, opekané na suchej panvici.
description.en: Thin Turkish flatbreads filled with spinach and feta, cooked in a dry pan.

steps.sk: Múku zmiešaj so soľou, jogurtom, lyžicou oleja a asi 100 ml vlažnej vody a vypracuj mäkké hladké cesto. Rozdeľ ho na 4 guľky, prikry a nechaj 30 minút odpočívať.
steps.en: Mix the flour with the salt, yogurt, a spoonful of oil and about 100 ml of lukewarm water and knead into a soft, smooth dough. Divide into 4 balls, cover and rest for 30 minutes.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno a opeč ju na zvyšnom oleji 4 minúty. Pridaj špenát a miešaj, kým nezvädne a voda sa neodparí. Nechaj ho vychladnúť, dobre vytlač a zmiešaj s rozdrobenou fetou a čili.
steps.en: Finely chop the onion and fry it in the remaining oil for 4 minutes. Add the spinach and stir until wilted and the liquid has evaporated. Let it cool, squeeze dry and mix with the crumbled feta and chilli.

steps.sk: Každú guľku rozvaľkaj na tenký obdĺžnik asi 30 × 20 cm. Na polovicu rozotri štvrtinu plnky, druhú polovicu preklop a okraje pritlač.
steps.en: Roll each ball into a thin rectangle of about 30 × 20 cm. Spread a quarter of the filling over half, fold the other half over and press the edges together.

steps.sk: Na suchej panvici na strednom ohni opekaj gözleme 2 až 3 minúty z každej strany, kým nemá zlatohnedé škvrny. Hneď ho potri maslom.
steps.en: Cook each gözleme in a dry pan over a medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side until patched with golden brown. Brush with butter straight away.

steps.sk: Nakrájaj na kúsky a podávaj teplé s citrónom a ayranom alebo jogurtom.
steps.en: Cut into pieces and serve warm with lemon and ayran or yogurt.

description.sk: Hustá zelená frittata s množstvom petržlenu, koriandra, kôpru a vlašskými orechmi.
description.en: A dense green frittata packed with parsley, coriander, dill and walnuts.

steps.sk: Bylinky umy, dôkladne osuš a otrhaj z hrubých stoniek. Spolu s jarnou cibuľkou ich nasekaj veľmi nadrobno – bylín má byť viac ako vajec, to je podstata kuku.
steps.en: Wash the herbs, dry them thoroughly and strip them from the thick stalks. Chop them very finely with the spring onions; there should be more herbs than egg, which is the point of kuku.

steps.sk: Vajcia rozšľahaj s kurkumou, kypriacim práškom a soľou. Vmiešaj bylinky, nahrubo nasekané orechy a brusnice.
steps.en: Beat the eggs with the turmeric, baking powder and salt. Stir in the herbs, roughly chopped walnuts and cranberries.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 180 °C. Na nepriľnavej panvici s kovovou rúčkou zohrej olej na strednom ohni, vlej zmes a uhlaď ju. Peč na plotni 6 až 8 minút, kým okraje a spodok nestuhnú.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Heat the oil in an ovenproof non-stick pan over a medium heat, pour in the mixture and level it. Cook on the hob for 6 to 8 minutes until the edges and base have set.

steps.sk: Panvicu prelož do rúry a peč 15 minút, kým stred nestuhne a nôž vyjde čistý. Nechaj 5 minút vychladnúť a vyklop na tanier.
steps.en: Move the pan to the oven and bake for 15 minutes until the centre has set and a knife comes out clean. Let it cool for 5 minutes and turn out onto a plate.

steps.sk: Nakrájaj na trojuholníky a podávaj teplé alebo studené s jogurtom a chlebom. V chladničke vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: Cut into wedges and serve warm or cold with yogurt and bread. It keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

title.sk: Tahdig – perzská ryža s chrumkavou kôrkou

description.sk: Basmati ryža uvarená v pare s chrumkavou zlatou kôrkou z jogurtu na dne hrnca.
description.en: Steamed basmati rice with a crisp golden yogurt crust from the bottom of the pot.

steps.sk: Ryžu preplachuj, kým voda nie je číra, a namoč ju na 30 minút do vlažnej vody. Potom ju vsyp do veľkého hrnca s 2 litrami vriacej osolenej vody a var 6 minút – zrnká majú byť mäkké na povrchu a tvrdé v strede.
steps.en: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear and soak it in lukewarm water for 30 minutes. Then tip it into a large pot with 2 litres of boiling salted water and cook for 6 minutes; the grains should be soft outside and firm inside.

steps.sk: Ryžu sceď a prepláchni vlažnou vodou. Tri naberačky ryže zmiešaj s jogurtom, žĺtkom, kurkumou a lyžicou oleja na žltú zmes.
steps.en: Drain the rice and rinse in lukewarm water. Mix three ladles of rice with the yogurt, egg yolk, turmeric and a spoonful of oil to make a yellow mixture.

steps.sk: V hrnci s hrubým dnom rozpusti polovicu masla so zvyšným olejom. Jogurtovú ryžu rozotri po dne a pritlač. Navrch nakôp zvyšnú ryžu do kužeľa, rúčkou varešky v nej urob 5 dierok až po dno a pokvapkaj rozpusteným zvyšným maslom.
steps.en: Melt half the butter with the remaining oil in a heavy-based pot. Spread the yogurt rice over the base and press it down. Pile the rest of the rice on top in a cone, poke 5 holes to the bottom with the handle of a wooden spoon and drizzle with the remaining melted butter.

steps.sk: Pokrievku zabaľ do utierky, aby zachytávala paru, a hrniec pevne prikry. Var 10 minút na strednom ohni, kým nepočuješ syčanie, potom zníž na minimum a nechaj 35 minút.
steps.en: Wrap the lid in a tea towel to catch the steam and cover the pot tightly. Cook for 10 minutes over a medium heat until you hear sizzling, then turn to the lowest heat and leave for 35 minutes.

steps.sk: Dno hrnca ponor na minútu do studenej vody v umývadle – kôrka sa uvoľní. Na hrniec polož veľký tanier a jedným pohybom ho obráť. Podávaj ryžu so zlatou kôrkou navrchu, k dusenému mäsu alebo zelenine.
steps.en: Stand the base of the pot in cold water in the sink for a minute; this loosens the crust. Put a large plate over the pot and flip it in one movement. Serve the rice with the golden crust on top, alongside a stew or vegetables.

title.sk: Batata harra – pikantné zemiaky s koriandrom
title.en: Batata harra: spicy potatoes with coriander

description.sk: Libanonské chrumkavé kocky zemiakov s cesnakom, čili, koriandrom a citrónom.
description.en: Lebanese crisp potato cubes with garlic, chilli, coriander and lemon.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 220 °C. Zemiaky ošúp a nakrájaj na kocky asi 2 cm. Premiešaj ich s 3 lyžicami oleja, paprikou a soľou a rozlož na plech v jednej vrstve.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 220 °C. Peel the potatoes and cut them into roughly 2 cm cubes. Toss with 3 tablespoons of oil, the paprika and salt and spread on a tray in a single layer.

steps.sk: Peč 30 až 35 minút, v polovici ich obráť, kým nie sú zlatohnedé a chrumkavé zo všetkých strán a vnútri mäkké.
steps.en: Roast for 30 to 35 minutes, turning halfway, until golden brown and crisp all over and soft inside.

steps.sk: Medzitým nasekaj cesnak, čili bez semienok a koriander. Na malej panvici zohrej zvyšný olej a cesnak s čili opekaj 1 minútu, kým nezavoňajú, no nezhnednú.
steps.en: Meanwhile chop the garlic, the deseeded chilli and the coriander. Heat the remaining oil in a small pan and fry the garlic and chilli for 1 minute until fragrant but not browned.

steps.sk: Horúce zemiaky prelož do misy, polej cesnakovým olejom, citrónovou šťavou a posyp koriandrom. Premiešaj a podávaj hneď ako mezze, prílohu alebo samostatne s jogurtom.
steps.en: Tip the hot potatoes into a bowl, pour over the garlic oil and lemon juice and scatter with the coriander. Toss and serve straight away as a mezze, side dish or on their own with yogurt.

description.sk: Vrstvy chrumkavej pity, teplého cíceru a cesnakového jogurtu s opraženými mandľami.
description.en: Layers of crisp pita, warm chickpeas and garlicky yogurt topped with toasted almonds.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 200 °C. Pity natrhaj na kúsky, premiešaj s olejom a peč 8 až 10 minút do zlatista a chrumkava.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Tear the pitas into pieces, toss with the oil and bake for 8 to 10 minutes until golden and crisp.

steps.sk: Cícer zohrej v hrnci so 200 ml vody, rascou a polovicou soli 5 minút. Medzitým vymiešaj jogurt s tahini, prelisovaným cesnakom, šťavou z citróna a zvyšnou soľou.
steps.en: Warm the chickpeas in a pan with 200 ml of water, the cumin and half the salt for 5 minutes. Meanwhile mix the yogurt with the tahini, crushed garlic, lemon juice and remaining salt.

steps.sk: Na plytkú misu rozlož chrumkavú pitu a pokvapkaj ju 3 lyžicami vody z cíceru, aby jemne zmäkla. Navrch daj scedený cícer a polej ho jogurtovou omáčkou.
steps.en: Spread the crisp pita over a shallow dish and sprinkle with 3 tablespoons of the chickpea water so it softens slightly. Top with the drained chickpeas and pour over the yogurt sauce.

steps.sk: Na malej panvici rozpusti maslo a mandle opekaj 2 až 3 minúty dozlatista, posyp paprikou. Horúce maslo s mandľami vylej na jogurt, posyp vňaťou a podávaj hneď, kým je pita ešte trochu chrumkavá.
steps.en: Melt the butter in a small pan and fry the almonds for 2 to 3 minutes until golden, then sprinkle with paprika. Pour the hot butter and almonds over the yogurt, scatter with parsley and serve at once while the pita still has some crunch.

title.sk: Tavuk sote – turecké kura s paprikou
title.en: Tavuk sote: Turkish chicken with peppers

description.sk: Kúsky kuracieho mäsa restované s paprikou, paradajkami a cibuľou, s bulgurom.
description.en: Pieces of chicken sautéed with peppers, tomatoes and onion, served with bulgur.

steps.sk: Kuracie prsia nakrájaj na kocky asi 2 cm, papriky a cibuľu na prúžky a paradajky na kocky. Bulgur zalej 500 ml vriacej osolenej vody, prikry a nechaj 15 minút napučať.
steps.en: Cut the chicken into roughly 2 cm cubes, the peppers and onion into strips and the tomatoes into dice. Pour 500 ml of boiling salted water over the bulgur, cover and leave to swell for 15 minutes.

steps.sk: Na veľkej panvici rozpáľ olej a mäso opekaj na vysokom ohni 5 minút, kým nie je zo všetkých strán zlatisté. Vyber ho na tanier.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the chicken over a high heat for 5 minutes until golden on all sides. Lift onto a plate.

steps.sk: Na tej istej panvici opekaj cibuľu a papriky 5 minút, pridaj cesnak, pretlak, papriku, čili a tymian a minútu opekaj. Pridaj paradajky a var 5 minút, kým nepustia šťavu.
steps.en: In the same pan fry the onion and peppers for 5 minutes, add the garlic, tomato paste, paprika, chilli and thyme and fry for a minute. Add the tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes until they release their juice.

steps.sk: Vráť mäso, osoľ a var ešte 5 minút, kým mäso nie je prepečené – bez ružovej farby vo vnútri – a omáčka hustá. Podávaj s bulgurom; v krabičkách vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: Return the chicken, season with salt and simmer for 5 more minutes until cooked through with no pink inside and the sauce is thick. Serve with the bulgur; in lunchboxes it keeps for 3 days.

description.sk: Arabské jedlo z jedného hrnca: kurča s ryžou, paradajkami, mrkvou a korením.
description.en: An Arabian one-pot of chicken with rice, tomatoes, carrot and warm spices.

steps.sk: Ryžu prepláchni a namoč na 20 minút. V širokom hrnci rozpáľ olej a stehná opeč na vysokom ohni 3 minúty z každej strany. Vyber ich.
steps.en: Rinse the rice and soak it for 20 minutes. Heat the oil in a wide pot and brown the chicken over a high heat for 3 minutes per side. Lift it out.

steps.sk: Na výpekoch opeč nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu 5 minút, pridaj cesnak, pretlak a všetko korenie a minútu opekaj, kým nezavonia. Pridaj nastrúhané paradajky a mrkvu nakrájanú na prúžky.
steps.en: Fry the finely chopped onion in the juices for 5 minutes, add the garlic, tomato paste and all the spices and fry for a minute until fragrant. Add the grated tomatoes and the carrots cut into strips.

steps.sk: Vráť mäso, zalej 700 ml vody s bujónom a soľou a var pod pokrievkou 25 minút. Potom pridaj scedenú ryžu a hrozienka, premiešaj a var na minimálnom ohni pod pokrievkou 18 minút, kým ryža nevpije tekutinu.
steps.en: Return the chicken, pour in 700 ml of water with the stock cube and salt and simmer, covered, for 25 minutes. Then add the drained rice and the raisins, stir and cook, covered, on the lowest heat for 18 minutes until the rice has absorbed the liquid.

steps.sk: Nechaj 10 minút odpočívať. Mandle opraž na suchej panvici 3 minúty. Ryžu prečechraj, vylov celé korenie, navrch polož kurča a posyp mandľami. V chladničke vydrží 3 dni.
steps.en: Rest for 10 minutes. Toast the almonds in a dry pan for 3 minutes. Fluff the rice, fish out the whole spices, put the chicken on top and scatter with the almonds. It keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

title.sk: Kuracie stehná so zatarom a citrónom

description.sk: Pečené stehná s chrumkavou kožou, korením zatar, citrónom a červenou cibuľou.
description.en: Roast thighs with crisp skin, za'atar spice, lemon and red onion.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 210 °C. Zmiešaj oregano, tymian, sezam a papriku – vznikne domáca zmes podobná zataru. Pridaj olej, prelisovaný cesnak, soľ a šťavu z polovice citróna.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 210 °C. Mix the oregano, thyme, sesame and paprika for a homemade za'atar-style blend. Add the oil, crushed garlic, salt and the juice of half the lemon.

steps.sk: Stehná osuš a dôkladne ich potri zmesou aj pod kožou. Cibuľu nakrájaj na mesiačiky a druhú polovicu citróna na plátky a rozlož ich na plech; navrch polož stehná kožou nahor.
steps.en: Pat the chicken dry and rub the mixture all over, including under the skin. Cut the onions into wedges and the other lemon half into slices and spread them on a tray; lay the chicken on top skin side up.

steps.sk: Peč 40 až 45 minút, kým koža nie je chrumkavá a tmavozlatá a pri kosti vyteká číra šťava. Medzitým zalej bulgur 500 ml vriacej osolenej vody a nechaj ho pod pokrievkou napučať.
steps.en: Roast for 40 to 45 minutes until the skin is crisp and deep golden and the juices run clear near the bone. Meanwhile pour 500 ml of boiling salted water over the bulgur and leave it covered to swell.

steps.sk: Podávaj stehná s bulgurom, karamelizovanou cibuľou a šťavou z plechu, prípadne s jogurtom.
steps.en: Serve the chicken with the bulgur, the caramelised onions and the pan juices, and yogurt if you like.

title.sk: Yayla – turecká jogurtová polievka s mätou
title.en: Yayla: Turkish yogurt soup with mint

description.sk: Hodvábna polievka z jogurtu, ryže a vajca s mätovým maslom.
description.en: A silky soup of yogurt, rice and egg finished with mint butter.

steps.sk: Ryžu prepláchni a var ju v 1 litri vody s bujónom 15 minút, kým nie je úplne mäkká.
steps.en: Rinse the rice and simmer it in 1 litre of water with the stock cube for 15 minutes until completely soft.

steps.sk: Medzitým v miske vymiešaj jogurt s vajcom a múkou do hladka. Múka a vajce zabránia tomu, aby sa jogurt v horúcej polievke zrazil.
steps.en: Meanwhile whisk the yogurt with the egg and flour until smooth. The flour and egg stop the yogurt curdling in the hot soup.

steps.sk: Za stáleho miešania prilievaj k jogurtu po naberačkách horúci vývar, kým sa zmes nezohreje. Potom ju vlej do hrnca a na miernom ohni stále miešaj 5 minút, kým polievka nezhustne. Nesmie prudko vrieť.
steps.en: Whisking constantly, add ladles of the hot broth to the yogurt until it warms up. Then pour it into the pot and stir constantly over a low heat for 5 minutes until the soup thickens. It must not boil hard.

steps.sk: Dochuť soľou. Na malej panvici rozpusti maslo, pridaj nasekanú mätu a čili a nechaj 30 sekúnd zašumieť. Polievku nalej do misiek a pokvapkaj mätovým maslom.
steps.en: Season with salt. Melt the butter in a small pan, add the chopped mint and chilli and let them sizzle for 30 seconds. Ladle the soup into bowls and drizzle with the mint butter.

description.sk: Krémový domáci hummus s opečeným korenistým jahňacím mäsom a píniovými orieškami.
description.en: Creamy homemade hummus topped with spiced fried lamb and pine nuts.

steps.sk: Cícer rozmixuj s tahini, šťavou z citróna, cesnakom, polovicou soli a 4 až 6 lyžicami ľadovej vody aspoň 3 minúty, kým nie je hummus úplne hladký a nadýchaný. Studená voda ho zosvetlí.
steps.en: Blend the chickpeas with the tahini, lemon juice, garlic, half the salt and 4 to 6 tablespoons of ice-cold water for at least 3 minutes until completely smooth and fluffy. The cold water makes it paler and lighter.

steps.sk: Na panvici zohrej lyžicu oleja a nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu opekaj 4 minúty. Pridaj jahňacie a opekaj na vysokom ohni 6 minút, kým sa nerozpadne a nie je chrumkavé.
steps.en: Heat a spoonful of oil in a pan and fry the finely chopped onion for 4 minutes. Add the lamb and fry over a high heat for 6 minutes, breaking it up, until browned and crisp.

steps.sk: Pridaj škoricu, nové korenie, rascu a zvyšnú soľ a minútu opekaj. Na suchej panvici opraž píniové oriešky 2 minúty dozlatista – rýchlo hnednú, preto ich miešaj.
steps.en: Add the cinnamon, allspice, cumin and remaining salt and fry for a minute. Toast the pine nuts in a dry pan for 2 minutes until golden; they brown fast, so keep stirring.

steps.sk: Hummus rozotri na taniere a vytvor v ňom jamku. Do jamky daj horúce mäso, posyp oriešky a vňaťou a pokvapkaj olejom. Podávaj s teplou pitou.
steps.en: Spread the hummus on plates and make a well in the middle. Spoon the hot lamb into the well, scatter with the pine nuts and parsley and drizzle with oil. Serve with warm pita.

title.sk: Kuracie tajine so sušenými slivkami a mandľami
title.en: Chicken tagine with prunes and almonds

description.sk: Marocké sladko-korenisté kura so škoricou, zázvorom, sušenými slivkami a medom.
description.en: Moroccan sweet and spiced chicken with cinnamon, ginger, prunes and honey.

steps.sk: Cibuľu nakrájaj na tenké polkolieska a cesnak nasekaj. V širokom hrnci zohrej olej, stehná opeč z oboch strán 3 minúty dozlatista a vyber ich.
steps.en: Slice the onions thinly into half-moons and chop the garlic. Heat the oil in a wide pot, brown the chicken for 3 minutes per side and lift it out.

steps.sk: Na výpekoch opekaj cibuľu 8 minút do mäkka a zlatista. Pridaj cesnak, zázvor, škoricu a kurkumu a minútu opekaj, kým korenie nezavonia.
steps.en: Fry the onions in the juices for 8 minutes until soft and golden. Add the garlic, ginger, cinnamon and turmeric and fry for a minute until fragrant.

steps.sk: Vráť mäso, zalej 400 ml vody s bujónom a soľou, prikry a dus na miernom ohni 30 minút. Potom pridaj slivky a med a var odkryté ďalších 15 minút, kým omáčka nezhustne na sirup a mäso sa neoddeľuje od kosti.
steps.en: Return the chicken, add 400 ml of water with the stock cube and salt, cover and simmer gently for 30 minutes. Then add the prunes and honey and simmer uncovered for another 15 minutes until the sauce is syrupy and the meat comes away from the bone.

steps.sk: Kuskus zalej 300 ml vriacej osolenej vody, prikry a nechaj 5 minút napučať, potom ho prečechraj vidličkou. Mandle opraž na suchej panvici 3 minúty dozlatista.
steps.en: Pour 300 ml of boiling salted water over the couscous, cover and leave to swell for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork. Toast the almonds in a dry pan for 3 minutes until golden.

steps.sk: Tajine podávaj na kuskuse, posypané mandľami a koriandrom. V chladničke vydrží 3 dni a zohriate chutí ešte lepšie.
steps.en: Serve the tagine on the couscous, scattered with the almonds and coriander. It keeps in the fridge for 3 days and tastes even better reheated.

description.sk: Marocký koláč z filo cesta s kuracím mäsom, vajcom, mandľami, škoricou a cukrom.
description.en: A Moroccan filo pie of chicken, egg, almonds, cinnamon and a dusting of sugar.

steps.sk: Do hrnca daj kura, nadrobno nakrájanú cibuľu, zázvor, kurkumu, polovicu škorice, soľ a 300 ml vody. Dus pod pokrievkou 35 minút, kým mäso nie je mäkké. Mäso vyber a natrhaj na prúžky.
steps.en: Put the chicken, finely chopped onions, ginger, turmeric, half the cinnamon, the salt and 300 ml of water in a pot. Simmer, covered, for 35 minutes until the meat is tender. Lift it out and shred it.

steps.sk: Šťavu s cibuľou var odkrytú, kým nezostane asi 200 ml. Zníž oheň, vlej rozšľahané vajcia a mešaj ako praženicu, kým nestuhnú do mäkkých vločiek. Vmiešaj kura a nasekaný koriander.
steps.en: Boil the liquid and onions uncovered until about 200 ml remains. Lower the heat, pour in the beaten eggs and stir like scrambled eggs until they set into soft curds. Fold in the chicken and chopped coriander.

steps.sk: Mandle opraž na suchej panvici, nasekaj nadrobno a zmiešaj s polovicou práškového cukru a štipkou škorice. Rúru predhrej na 190 °C a maslo rozpusti.
steps.en: Toast the almonds in a dry pan, chop them finely and mix with half the icing sugar and a pinch of cinnamon. Preheat the oven to 190 °C and melt the butter.

steps.sk: Formu s priemerom 24 cm vystel plátmi filo cesta, každý potri maslom a nechaj ich prečnievať cez okraj – spolu 6 plátov. Rozotri mäsovú zmes, posyp mandľami a prečnievajúce pláty preklop na vrch. Prikry ďalšími 4 potretými plátmi a okraje zastrč pod koláč.
steps.en: Line a 24 cm tin with sheets of filo, brushing each with butter and letting them overhang the edge, 6 sheets in all. Spread over the meat mixture, scatter with the almonds and fold the overhanging sheets over the top. Cover with 4 more buttered sheets and tuck the edges under.

steps.sk: Peč 25 až 30 minút do zlatohneda a chrumkava. Nechaj 5 minút postáť, vyklop na tanier, posyp zvyšným práškovým cukrom a škoricou v mriežke. Sladko-slaná kombinácia je pre bastillu typická.
steps.en: Bake for 25 to 30 minutes until golden brown and crisp. Let it stand for 5 minutes, turn out onto a plate and dust with the remaining icing sugar and cinnamon in a lattice. The sweet and savoury mix is typical of bastilla.

description.sk: Teplý šalát z dusených baklažánov a paradajok s cesnakom, rascou a koriandrom.
description.en: A warm salad of stewed aubergine and tomatoes with garlic, cumin and coriander.

steps.sk: Baklažány ošúp v pruhoch a nakrájaj na kocky asi 2 cm. Paradajky ošúp – nakroj ich do kríža, na 30 sekúnd ponor do vriacej vody a šupka sa zošúpne – a nakrájaj na kocky.
steps.en: Peel the aubergines in stripes and cut into roughly 2 cm cubes. Peel the tomatoes by scoring a cross, dipping them in boiling water for 30 seconds and slipping off the skins, then chop them.

steps.sk: V širokom hrnci zohrej olej, pridaj baklažán, cesnak, rascu, papriku, čili a soľ a 5 minút opekaj. Pridaj paradajky a 100 ml vody.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a wide pan, add the aubergine, garlic, cumin, paprika, chilli and salt and fry for 5 minutes. Add the tomatoes and 100 ml of water.

steps.sk: Dus pod pokrievkou na miernom ohni 20 minút, kým baklažán úplne nezmäkne. Potom odkry a vareškou zmes roztlač na hrubú kašu a var ďalších 10 minút, kým sa tekutina neodparí a šalát nezhustne.
steps.en: Cook, covered, over a low heat for 20 minutes until the aubergine is completely soft. Then uncover, crush the mixture into a rough purée with the spoon and cook for another 10 minutes until the liquid evaporates and it thickens.

steps.sk: Dochuť citrónovou šťavou a vmiešaj nasekaný koriander. Podávaj teplý alebo izbovej teploty s pitou. V chladničke vydrží 5 dní.
steps.en: Season with lemon juice and stir in the chopped coriander. Serve warm or at room temperature with pita. It keeps in the fridge for 5 days.

description.sk: Hustá vegánska polievka z hrachu s rascou, cesnakom, olivovým olejom a paprikou.
description.en: A thick vegan split pea soup with cumin, garlic, olive oil and paprika.

steps.sk: Hrach prepláchni. Daj ho do hrnca s nakrájanou cibuľou, celými strúčikmi cesnaku, polovicou rasce a 1,3 litrom vody. Priveď do varu, zober penu a var na miernom ohni 50 až 60 minút, kým sa hrach nerozpadá.
steps.en: Rinse the split peas. Put them in a pot with the chopped onion, whole garlic cloves, half the cumin and 1.3 litres of water. Bring to the boil, skim and simmer gently for 50 to 60 minutes until the peas fall apart.

steps.sk: Polievku rozmixuj dohladka s 2 lyžicami oleja, soľou a citrónovou šťavou. Má byť hustá ako krém – ak je príliš hustá, prilej horúcu vodu.
steps.en: Blend the soup until smooth with 2 tablespoons of oil, the salt and the lemon juice. It should be as thick as cream; add hot water if it is too thick.

steps.sk: Zvyšnú rascu krátko opraž na suchej panvici, kým nezavonia, a zmiešaj ju s paprikou a čili.
steps.en: Briefly toast the remaining cumin in a dry pan until fragrant and mix it with the paprika and chilli.

steps.sk: Polievku nalej do misiek, pokvapkaj zvyšným olejom a posyp korením. V Maroku sa bissara je na raňajky s chlebom. V chladničke vydrží 4 dni, zamrazená 3 mesiace.
steps.en: Ladle into bowls, drizzle with the remaining oil and sprinkle with the spice mix. In Morocco bissara is eaten for breakfast with bread. It keeps in the fridge for 4 days and freezes for 3 months.

title.sk: Marocký mrkvový šalát s rascou a pomarančom
title.en: Moroccan carrot salad with cumin and orange

description.sk: Krátko uvarená mrkva s rascou, cesnakom, pomarančom a mätou, vegánska.
description.en: Briefly cooked carrots with cumin, garlic, orange and mint, vegan.

steps.sk: Mrkvu ošúp a nakrájaj na kolieska hrubé asi 5 mm. Var ju v osolenej vode 5 až 6 minút, kým nezmäkne, ale je ešte jemne pevná. Sceď ju a prepláchni studenou vodou.
steps.en: Peel the carrots and slice them about 5 mm thick. Boil in salted water for 5 to 6 minutes until tender but still slightly firm. Drain and rinse under cold water.

steps.sk: Rascu krátko opraž na suchej panvici. V miske zmiešaj olej, šťavu z citróna a z polovice pomaranča, prelisovaný cesnak, rascu, papriku, škoricu a soľ.
steps.en: Briefly toast the cumin in a dry pan. In a bowl mix the oil, the juice of the lemon and half the orange, the crushed garlic, cumin, paprika, cinnamon and salt.

steps.sk: Druhú polovicu pomaranča ošúp a nakrájaj na kúsky. Mrkvu premiešaj s dresingom a pomarančom a nechaj aspoň 15 minút postáť, aby nasala chuť.
steps.en: Peel the other orange half and cut it into pieces. Toss the carrots with the dressing and orange and leave for at least 15 minutes to soak up the flavour.

steps.sk: Pred podávaním posyp natrhanou mätou. Šalát je dobrý ako príloha k mäsu aj samostatne; v chladničke vydrží 4 dni.
steps.en: Scatter with torn mint before serving. The salad works as a side to meat or on its own; it keeps in the fridge for 4 days.

title.sk: Tuniský brik s vajcom a tuniakom
title.en: Tunisian brik with egg and tuna

description.sk: Chrumkavé trojuholníky z filo cesta plnené tuniakom, kaparami a celým vajcom.
description.en: Crisp filo triangles filled with tuna, capers and a whole egg.

note.sk: toľko vsiakne; na vyprážanie priprav asi 300 ml
note.en: this much is absorbed; have about 300 ml for frying

steps.sk: Zemiak uvar v šupke doměkka, ošúp a roztlač. Zmiešaj ho s rozdrobeným tuniakom, nasekanými kaparami, nadrobno nakrájanou cibuľou, petržlenovou vňaťou a korením.
steps.en: Boil the potato in its skin until tender, then peel and mash it. Mix with the flaked tuna, chopped capers, finely chopped onion, parsley and pepper.

steps.sk: V hlbšej panvici zohrej olej na strednom ohni. Dva pláty filo polož na seba a prelož napoly do štvorca. Do stredu daj štvrtinu plnky a vytvor v nej jamku.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a deep pan over a medium heat. Lay two sheets of filo on top of each other and fold in half to make a square. Put a quarter of the filling in the middle and make a hollow in it.

steps.sk: Do jamky opatrne rozbi vajce a hneď cesto preklop na trojuholník, okraje pritlač. Rýchlo, ale jemne ho prenes do horúceho oleja – vajce nesmie vytiecť.
steps.en: Carefully crack an egg into the hollow and immediately fold the pastry into a triangle, pressing the edges together. Lift it quickly but gently into the hot oil; the egg must not run out.

steps.sk: Vyprážaj 1 až 2 minúty z každej strany, kým nie je brik zlatohnedý a chrumkavý a bielok stuhnutý, žĺtok mäkký. Vyber ho na papierovú utierku a rovnako priprav zvyšné.
steps.en: Fry for 1 to 2 minutes per side until golden brown and crisp, with the white set and the yolk soft. Drain on kitchen paper and make the rest the same way.

steps.sk: Podávaj hneď s mesiačikmi citróna. Brik sa je rukami – opatrne, žĺtok vytečie pri prvom zahryznutí.
steps.en: Serve straight away with lemon wedges. Brik is eaten by hand; careful, the yolk runs out at the first bite.

title.en: Hawawshi: pita stuffed with spiced meat

description.sk: Egyptské pouličné jedlo: pita plnená mletým mäsom s cibuľou, paprikou a korením, upečená dochrumkava.
description.en: Egyptian street food: pita stuffed with spiced minced meat, onion and pepper, baked crisp.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 220 °C. Cibuľu, papriku a čili bez semienok nakrájaj veľmi nadrobno a petržlenovú vňať nasekaj. Zeleninu jemne vytlač v utierke, aby plnka nebola vodnatá.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 220 °C. Chop the onion, pepper and deseeded chilli very finely and chop the parsley. Squeeze the vegetables lightly in a towel so the filling is not watery.

steps.sk: Mäso zmiešaj so zeleninou, vňaťou, rascou, koriandrom, novým korením a soľou a rukou dôkladne premiešaj.
steps.en: Mix the meat with the vegetables, parsley, cumin, coriander, allspice and salt and work it together well by hand.

steps.sk: Pity opatrne nakroj na jednom okraji a otvor ako vrecko. Do každej natlač štvrtinu mäsa v tenkej rovnomernej vrstve – musí sa prepiecť zároveň s chlebom. Pity zvonku potri olejom.
steps.en: Carefully slit the pitas along one edge and open them like pockets. Press a quarter of the meat into each in a thin, even layer; it has to cook through in the same time as the bread. Brush the outside with oil.

steps.sk: Ulož ich na plech a peč 18 až 20 minút, v polovici ich otoč, kým nie je pita chrumkavá a mäso vo vnútri prepečené, bez ružovej farby. Nakrájaj na trojuholníky a podávaj s jogurtom a šalátom.
steps.en: Place them on a tray and bake for 18 to 20 minutes, turning halfway, until the pita is crisp and the meat inside is cooked through with no pink. Cut into triangles and serve with yogurt and salad.

description.sk: Pikantné placky z jahňacieho mäsa s rascou, feniklom a paprikou na zeleninovom kuskuse.
description.en: Spicy lamb patties with cumin, fennel and paprika on vegetable couscous.

steps.sk: Mäso zmiešaj s prelisovaným cesnakom, paprikou, čili, rascou, koriandrom, pretlakom a polovicou soli – zmes pripomína korenie na klobásy merguez. Vytvaruj 12 podlhovastých placiek a daj ich na 15 minút do chladničky.
steps.en: Mix the lamb with the crushed garlic, paprika, chilli, cumin, coriander, tomato paste and half the salt; the blend echoes merguez sausage spice. Shape 12 oblong patties and chill for 15 minutes.

steps.sk: Cuketu a papriku nakrájaj na drobné kocky a opeč na lyžici oleja 5 minút. Kuskus daj do misky so zvyšnou soľou a lyžicou oleja, zalej 300 ml vriacej vody, prikry a nechaj 5 minút napučať.
steps.en: Dice the courgette and pepper small and fry in a spoonful of oil for 5 minutes. Put the couscous in a bowl with the remaining salt and a spoonful of oil, pour over 300 ml of boiling water, cover and leave for 5 minutes.

steps.sk: Na panvici rozpáľ zvyšný olej a placky opekaj na strednom až vysokom ohni 3 až 4 minúty z každej strany, kým nie sú zvonku opečené a vo vnútri prepečené.
steps.en: Heat the remaining oil in a pan and fry the patties over a medium-high heat for 3 to 4 minutes per side until browned outside and cooked through.

steps.sk: Kuskus prečechraj vidličkou a vmiešaj zeleninu a natrhanú mätu. Podávaj s plackami a jogurtom.
steps.en: Fluff the couscous with a fork and stir in the vegetables and torn mint. Serve with the patties and yogurt.

description.sk: Hustá vegánska šošovica dusená s paradajkami, rascou, paprikou a koriandrom.
description.en: Thick vegan lentils stewed with tomatoes, cumin, paprika and coriander.

steps.sk: Šošovicu prepláchni. Cibuľu nakrájaj nadrobno a cesnak nasekaj. V hrnci zohrej olej a cibuľu opekaj 5 minút, pridaj cesnak a všetko korenie a minútu opekaj.
steps.en: Rinse the lentils. Finely chop the onion and garlic. Heat the oil in a pot and fry the onion for 5 minutes, then add the garlic and all the spices and fry for a minute.

steps.sk: Pridaj šošovicu, paradajky a 800 ml vody. Priveď do varu a var pod pokrievkou na miernom ohni 30 až 35 minút, kým šošovica nie je mäkká a omáčka hustá. Občas premiešaj.
steps.en: Add the lentils, tomatoes and 800 ml of water. Bring to the boil and simmer, covered, over a low heat for 30 to 35 minutes until the lentils are tender and the sauce is thick. Stir now and then.

steps.sk: Dochuť soľou a citrónovou šťavou a vmiešaj polovicu nasekaného koriandra. Ak je šošovica príliš hustá, prilej trochu vody.
steps.en: Season with salt and lemon juice and stir in half the chopped coriander. If it is too thick, add a little water.

steps.sk: Podávaj posypanú zvyšným koriandrom, s chlebom alebo kuskusom. Do krabičiek ideálna, v chladničke vydrží 4 dni a dá sa zamraziť.
steps.en: Serve sprinkled with the remaining coriander, with bread or couscous. Ideal for lunchboxes, it keeps in the fridge for 4 days and freezes well.

title.sk: Salade méchouia s tuniakom a vajcom
title.en: Salade méchouia with tuna and egg

description.sk: Tuniský šalát z pečených paprík a paradajok s cesnakom, tuniakom a vajcom.
description.en: A Tunisian salad of roasted peppers and tomatoes with garlic, tuna and egg.

steps.sk: Rúru predhrej na 230 °C. Papriky, paradajky a cibuľu na polovice ulož na plech a peč 25 až 30 minút, kým šupky nezčernejú a zelenina nezmäkne.
steps.en: Preheat the oven to 230 °C. Lay the peppers, tomatoes and halved onion on a tray and roast for 25 to 30 minutes until the skins blacken and the vegetables soften.

steps.sk: Papriky daj do misky, prikry a nechaj 10 minút zapariť. Medzitým uvar vajcia natvrdo 10 minút. Z paprík aj paradajok zošúp šupky a vyber semienka.
steps.en: Put the peppers in a bowl, cover and leave to steam for 10 minutes. Meanwhile hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes. Peel the skins off the peppers and tomatoes and remove the seeds.

steps.sk: Zeleninu aj cibuľu nasekaj nožom nadrobno na hrubú zmes. Pridaj prelisovaný cesnak, rascu, olej, citrónovú šťavu a soľ a premiešaj.
steps.en: Chop the vegetables and onion finely with a knife into a rough mixture. Add the crushed garlic, cumin, oil, lemon juice and salt and mix.

steps.sk: Šalát rozotri na tanier, navrch rozlož rozdrobeného tuniaka, vajcia nakrájané na štvrtiny a olivy. Podávaj s chlebom; šalát bez vajec vydrží v chladničke 3 dni.
steps.en: Spread the salad on a plate and top with the flaked tuna, quartered eggs and olives. Serve with bread; without the eggs the salad keeps in the fridge for 3 days.

description.sk: Marocké rybacie guľky s koriandrom a rascou dusené v pikantnej paradajkovej omáčke.
description.en: Moroccan fish balls with coriander and cumin poached in a spicy tomato sauce.

steps.sk: Rybu nakrájaj na kúsky a v mixéri ju krátko nasekaj s ryžou, vajcom, 2 strúčikmi cesnaku, polovicou koriandra, polovicou rasce a papriky a polovicou soli. Zmes má byť súdržná, nie úplne hladká.
steps.en: Cut the fish into pieces and pulse it briefly in a processor with the rice, egg, 2 garlic cloves, half the coriander, half the cumin and paprika and half the salt. The mixture should hold together but not be completely smooth.

steps.sk: Mokrými rukami z nej vytvaruj guľky veľkosti vlašského orecha, asi 20 kusov, a daj ich na 15 minút do chladničky – lepšie budú držať tvar.
steps.en: With wet hands shape walnut-sized balls, about 20, and chill them for 15 minutes so they keep their shape.

steps.sk: V širokom hrnci zohrej olej, pridaj zvyšný nasekaný cesnak, rascu, papriku a čili a 30 sekúnd opekaj. Pridaj paradajky, papriku nakrájanú na prúžky, zvyšnú soľ a 200 ml vody a var 10 minút.
steps.en: Heat the oil in a wide pan, add the remaining chopped garlic, cumin, paprika and chilli and fry for 30 seconds. Add the tomatoes, the pepper cut into strips, the remaining salt and 200 ml of water and simmer for 10 minutes.

steps.sk: Guľky opatrne vlož do omáčky, prikry a dus na miernom ohni 15 minút. Nemiešaj, iba ich raz opatrne otoč lyžicou – sú jemné a ľahko sa rozpadnú. Hotové sú biele a pevné.
steps.en: Gently lower the balls into the sauce, cover and simmer over a low heat for 15 minutes. Do not stir; just turn them once carefully with a spoon, as they are delicate. They are done when white and firm.

steps.sk: Pokvapkaj citrónom, posyp zvyšným koriandrom a podávaj s chlebom alebo ryžou.
steps.en: Squeeze over the lemon, scatter with the remaining coriander and serve with bread or rice.

description.sk: Pikantné cestoviny uvarené priamo v paradajkovej omáčke s kuracím mäsom, paprikou a rascou.
description.en: Spicy pasta cooked right in a tomato sauce with chicken, paprika and caraway.

steps.sk: Mäso nakrájaj na kúsky, cibuľu nadrobno a cesnak nasekaj. V širokom hrnci zohrej olej a mäso opeč na vysokom ohni 5 minút. Pridaj cibuľu a opekaj ďalšie 4 minúty.
steps.en: Cut the chicken into pieces, finely chop the onion and chop the garlic. Heat the oil in a wide pot and brown the chicken over a high heat for 5 minutes. Add the onion and fry for 4 more minutes.

steps.sk: Pridaj cesnak, pretlak, čili, papriku, rascu a koriander a 2 minúty opekaj za stáleho miešania, kým pretlak nestmavne. Korenistá pasta nahrádza tuniskú harissu.
steps.en: Add the garlic, tomato paste, chilli, paprika, caraway and coriander and fry for 2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the paste darkens. This spiced paste stands in for Tunisian harissa.

steps.sk: Zalej 900 ml horúcej vody s bujónom a soľou, priveď do varu a var 10 minút. Potom vsyp cestoviny a var za občasného miešania podľa času na obale, kým nie sú mäkké a omáčka nezhustne.
steps.en: Pour in 900 ml of hot water with the stock cube and salt, bring to the boil and simmer for 10 minutes. Then add the pasta and cook, stirring now and then, for the time on the packet until tender and the sauce has thickened.

steps.sk: Ak sa tekutina vpije skôr, než sú cestoviny hotové, prilej trochu vody. Posyp vňaťou a podávaj horúce.
steps.en: If the liquid is absorbed before the pasta is done, add a little water. Sprinkle with parsley and serve hot.

title.sk: Baghrir – marocké palacinky s tisícom dierok

description.sk: Mäkké krupicové palacinky pečené len z jednej strany, s medovým maslom.
description.en: Soft semolina pancakes cooked on one side only, with honey butter.

steps.sk: Do mixéra daj krupicu, múku, droždie, cukor, štipku soli, mlieko a 250 ml vlažnej vody a mixuj 2 minúty na hladké riedke cesto, ako na tenké palacinky.
steps.en: Put the semolina, flour, yeast, sugar, a pinch of salt, the milk and 250 ml of lukewarm water in a blender and blend for 2 minutes into a smooth, thin batter, like for crêpes.

steps.sk: Nechaj cesto prikryté 30 minút na teplom mieste, kým sa na povrchu neobjavia bublinky. Tesne pred pečením vmiešaj kypriaci prášok.
steps.en: Leave the batter covered in a warm place for 30 minutes until bubbles appear on the surface. Just before cooking, stir in the baking powder.

steps.sk: Nepriľnavú panvicu zohrej na strednom ohni bez tuku. Nalej naberačku cesta – nerozťahuj ho – a peč 2 až 3 minúty iba z jednej strany, kým celý povrch nie je pokrytý dierkami a nezmatnie. Neotáčaj ju.
steps.en: Heat a non-stick pan over a medium heat without fat. Pour in a ladle of batter without spreading it and cook for 2 to 3 minutes on one side only, until the whole surface is covered in holes and looks dry. Do not flip it.

steps.sk: Hotové palacinky ukladaj vedľa seba na utierku, nie na seba, kým vychladnú, inak by sa zlepili. Maslo rozpusti s medom, palacinky polej teplým medovým maslom a podávaj.
steps.en: Lay the finished pancakes side by side on a tea towel, not stacked, until cool, or they stick together. Melt the butter with the honey, pour the warm honey butter over the pancakes and serve.
